GenBank accession X99686
MECP2 sequences registered in GenBank, accession number X99686
3 missense, 3 nonsense, and 6 frameshift disease mutations; plus 4 missense and 2 silent benign variants

Nonsense (R168X, R270X, R294X) and frameshift mutations (201GlyFS-235X, 269AlaFS-288X, and microdeletions of 34bp, 388bp, 259bp, 154bp) introduce premature stop codons; R168X and 201GlyFS-235X delete the whole TRD domain; 154-bp deletion results in lack of large C-terminal portion
Nonsense and frameshift mutations produce truncated protein via premature stop codons; missense mutations affect functional domains (MBD, TRD); may critically affect function of MeCP2
T158M, R168X, R306C, and 269AlaFS-288X are common mutations also reported in previous studies (Amir et al. 1999; Wan et al. 1999)

Methyl-CpG binding domain (MBD, amino acids 78-160) and transcriptional repression domain (TRD, amino acids 207-311); most nucleotide substitutions are C->T transitions at CpG hotspots (16 of 21 C->T transitions at CpG hotspots)

201GlyFS-235X stop after 34 aa; 269AlaFS-288X stop after 19 aa; 34-bp del stop after 15 aa; 388-bp del stop after 69 aa; 259-bp del stop after 17 aa; 154-bp del stop after 11 aa (loss of large C-terminal portion)
